anicathedral.name: Cathedral of Ani
anicathedral.slogan: A great dome gone, the walls still holding the sky.
anicathedral.line: Begun in 989 and finished around 1001, it was designed by Trdat, the most celebrated architect of medieval Armenia.

anitigran.name: St Gregory of Tigran Honents
anitigran.slogan: Painted saints still glow inside a ruined city.
anitigran.line: A merchant named Tigran Honents paid for it in 1215, and its frescoes tell the lives of Saint Gregory and Christ.

karskalesi.name: Kars Castle
karskalesi.slogan: Black basalt keeping watch over the Kars River.
karskalesi.line: Rebuilt in 1153, razed by Timur in 1386, then rebuilt again in 1579 on the orders of Sultan Murad III.

karskumbet.name: Church of the Apostles
karskumbet.slogan: A Bagratid church that became a mosque and a church again.
karskumbet.line: Built in the 10th century when Kars was the Bagratid capital, it became a mosque in 1579 and again in 1993.

karsfethiye.name: Fethiye Mosque
karsfethiye.slogan: Russian domes on an Ottoman skyline.
karsfethiye.line: Built as a Russian military cathedral in tribute to Alexander Nevsky, it now serves as a mosque.
